development_api_key.description: Maps Platform API key for local dev and feature-branch builds; merged into Gradle MAPS_API_KEY by setup-secrets (default). Enable Directions API on the same Cloud project/key for arrival/route info.

release_api_key.description: Maps Platform API key for release builds; use setup-secrets with OUTREACH_MAPS_KEY_FIELD=release_api_key (e.g. GitHub Actions release bundle job) to merge into MAPS_API_KEY.

google_services.description: Must match the structure of Firebase android/google-services.json.
